notes: Created comprehensive implementation plan covering two change requests: (1) Shaped Crop Overlay — make crop preview dark overlay, border, and shape overlay match panel geometry for non-rect panels; (2) Swap in All Layouts — extend panel image swap drag-and-drop from hexagonal-only to all layouts. Plan features 5 phases across both features: Phase 2.1 (PanelSwap refactoring — rename file, remove hex guard), Phase 2.2 (Pointer coordination — restructure GestureHandler/MultiTouchHandler/SwapHandler interaction), Phase 2.3 (State/render rename — hexDragTargetId → dragTargetId), Phase 1.1 (Shaped dark overlay — clip + destination-out compositing), Phase 1.2 (Enhanced shape overlay + shaped crop border). Included BDD scenarios at all three levels (user behavior, component behavior, pure function behavior) with 30+ Given-When-Then scenarios. Included unit test scenarios (25+), E2E test scenarios (9), and manual testing steps. Consulted world-review for UX edge cases (small triangles, panel count mismatches, undo complexity, accessibility) and planner for technical approach (pointer coordination matrix, Canvas 2D clip strategy, gesture-active flag pattern). Feature 2 prioritized first per world-review (lower risk, state management + guard removal vs Canvas 2D rendering changes).
